title: AgentLite: A Lightweight Library for LLM Agent Development

defines.name: AgentLite
defines.definition: A lightweight, research-oriented library for developing, implementing, and evaluating LLM-based agent and multi-agent systems with task-oriented design and hierarchical orchestration.

problem: Existing agent libraries are too complex or rigid to easily prototype and evaluate new reasoning strategies and agent architectures for LLM agents.
